messages:
ana-partners: Quick sync: large SI + HW vendor asked for a private marketplace offer that smooths an 18mo commit. they want onboarding credits, HW rebate managed separately, and joint PR. can we draft guardrails?

marta-sales: We need finance caps and renewal cliffs. propose onboarding credit capped at 25% of Y1 commit, vesting over Q1-Q2. clarify whether SI gets referral fees.

jeff-finance: Agree on cap. Require audit rights and a clawback formula if they miss usage thresholds in year 2. Also model AR deferral if credit recognized upfront.

sam-engineering: Technical must-haves: reserved SKU or dedicated pool for burst, routing policy (primary region, fallback), allowed model variants, and telemetry tags for usage attribution. otherwise latency SLOs can break.

rajesh-legal: I will draft: (1) measurement authority clause (marketplace metering by default), (2) 12mo audit right, (3) explicit separation of HW rebate language so it can't offset our onboarding credit unless reconciled.

liz-gpmkt: Marketing asks: 6 weeks lead for joint assets; require at least $50k MDF from partner to unlock co-branded PR. suggest staged announce: contract sign + month-6 milestone case study.

marta-sales: Sales playbook: include a "concierge onboarding" one-pager outlining credit vesting tied to integration milestones to reduce churn risk.

ana-partners: I'll compile a bundled private-offer term sheet with: 25% cap, amortization schedule, routing appendix, MDF ask, renewal thresholds (>=90% --> +2% discount; <60% --> clawback). dropping draft here tomorrow EOD.

jeff-finance: Also add a clause that onboarding credit is applied as marketplace credits only, not cash, and cannot be used for HW purchase.

rajesh-legal: Noted. will include clawback math and sample audit language.

ana-partners: thanks all 44d - will circulate draft.
